title: Isolation and Confinement

primary_sources.note: Spaceflight and ground-analog behavioral/physiological studies since 1961

affected_organ_systems.label: Behavioral Health, Sleep & Circadian Rhythm
affected_organ_systems.evidence_summary: Long-duration confinement and altered light-dark cycles can contribute to sleep disruption, fatigue, and mood changes.

behavioral_indicators_without_clinical_o.interpretation_boundary: Self-reported or tracked sleep duration is a wellness indicator only, not a psychiatric diagnosis.
Voluntary crew check-in; missing check-ins indicate NO_DATA, never unconsciousness or pathology.

limitations: Behavioral indicators support self-awareness and crew check-ins; they do not diagnose depression, anxiety, or clinical disorders.
